SELECT "order_items"."datetrunc_utf8__" "month", "order_items"."product_type" "product_type", "order_items"."avg_order_items_" "avg_item_revenue", "order_items"."max_order_items_" "max_item_revenue" 
FROM (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', timezone('UTC', "order_items".ordered_at::timestamptz)) "datetrunc_utf8__", "order_items".product_type "product_type", avg("order_items".item_revenue_cents / 100.0) "avg_order_items_", max("order_items".item_revenue_cents / 100.0) "max_order_items_" 
  FROM  comparison_order_items  AS "order_items"
  GROUP BY 1, 2
) AS "order_items"
ORDER BY "order_items"."datetrunc_utf8__" ASC NULLS LAST, "order_items"."product_type" ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 50000
